en.sub: DCF · P/E · P/B · SOTP vs. market price — illustrative only, not investment advice
en.disc: Based on audited FY2025 results and the 18 Sep 2026 close of 180.0 IDR. Weighted shares 20.59 bn; parent BVPS 304.1; EPS 20.55; EBITDA 1,735.5 bn; net debt (1H26) 1,663 bn (debt 4,863 − cash 3,200). DCF net-debt basis is the more conservative 1H26 figure.
methods: Audited parent BVPS 304.1; 0.6x matches current level
EBITDA 1,735.5; 6% growth; WACC 10%; 55% parent share; net debt 1,663
en.weightNote: Weighted fair value = 35% P/E + 25% P/B + 30% DCF + 10% SOTP. Liquidation value is shown separately as an asset-backing reference.
key: Land sale timing drives revenue recognition and EPS volatility (1H26 -11%).
Infrastructure mix compresses gross margin; power profitability depends on gas price and PLN dispatch.
After refinancing, interest cost rose to ~7.2%; DCF uses a 10% WACC and 55% parent share of FCF.
Fair-value range is an illustration, not a recommendation; credit rating remains speculative grade (B- / B3).

methods: BVPS induk audit 304,1; 0,6x sesuai level saat ini
EBITDA 1.735,5; pertumbuhan 6%; WACC 10%; porsi induk 55%; utang bersih 1.663
id.weightNote: Nilai wajar tertimbang = 35% P/E + 25% P/B + 30% DCF + 10% SOTP. Nilai likuidasi ditampilkan terpisah sebagai referensi aset-penopang.
key: Timing penjualan lahan menggerakkan pengakuan pendapatan dan volatilitas EPS (1H26 -11%).

en.sub: What an asset/creditor-backing view implies per share — illustrative, not an offer or investment advice
en.disc: Method: start from the audited 31-Dec-2025 balance sheet (total assets 15,056.2, total liabilities 6,911.9, non-controlling interest 1,880.8, parent equity 6,263.6); revalue land for development (book 5,783.5) at market asking prices per project (Cikarang 7.3–17.2x, Kendal 4.9–14.1x, Tanjung Lesung 2.4–22.4x of book; Morotai kept at book); deduct all liabilities and the NCI; per share = 20.59 bn weighted shares.
en.note: Caveats: asking prices are third-party listings (Jul–Sep 2026), not transactions; no haircut on receivables, PP&E or other assets; land sales are the core going-concern business, so a liquidation shortcut understates (or, at high asking prices, overstates) the operating franchise; comparison uses the 17-Sep close of 180.0.

en.sub: Book value of land for development × 100% / 75% / 50% / 25% ÷ 20.59 bn weighted shares — separate asset reference, not combined with the valuation methods above
en.disc: Method & data source: total land bank book value = 5,783.5 IDR bn, the audited 31-Dec-2025 carrying value (at cost) of land for development (AR2025 note 7: Cikarang 3,482.0 + Kendal 746.6 + Tanjung Lesung 1,499.7 + Morotai 55.2). Per share = book value × factor ÷ 20.59 bn weighted shares (AR2025); comparison price = 180.0 IDR (18-Sep-2026 close). Gross asset view: liabilities and net debt are NOT deducted here (total liabilities 6,911.9; 1H26 net debt 1,663.0), so per-share figures are land value only, not an equity value.
en.note: Safety margin is shown only when the per-share figure exceeds the market price; 'n/a' means the land-backed value sits below the price. Book value is at cost, not market: market asking prices per project range from 2.4x to 22.4x of book (Land Bank page). The 75% / 50% / 25% factors illustrate book-value haircuts; actual recoverable value depends on sale timing, parcel mix and compulsory-sale discounts.

id.sub: Nilai buku lahan untuk pengembangan × 100% / 75% / 50% / 25% ÷ 20,59 miliar saham tertimbang — referensi aset terpisah, tidak digabung dengan metode valuasi di atas
id.disc: Metode & sumber data: total nilai buku lahan = 5.783,5 Rp miliar, nilai tercatat (biaya perolehan) audit 31 Des 2025 untuk lahan pengembangan (catatan 7 AR2025: Cikarang 3.482,0 + Kendal 746,6 + Tanjung Lesung 1.499,7 + Morotai 55,2). Per saham = nilai buku × faktor ÷ 20,59 miliar saham tertimbang (AR2025); harga pembanding = 180,0 IDR (penutupan 18 Sep 2026). Pandangan aset bruto: liabilitas dan utang bersih TIDAK dikurangkan di sini (total liabilitas 6.911,9; utang bersih 1H26 1.663,0), sehingga angka per saham hanyalah nilai lahan, bukan nilai ekuitas.

Nilai buku adalah biaya perolehan, bukan pasar: harga penawaran per proyek berkisar 2,4x-22,4x dari buku (halaman Land Bank). Faktor 75% / 50% / 25% mengilustrasikan pemangkasan nilai buku; nilai yang dapat dipulihkan aktual bergantung pada waktu penjualan, campuran bidang tanah, dan diskon jual paksa.

zh.sub: 开发土地账面价值 × 100% / 75% / 50% / 25% ÷ 205.9 亿股 —— 独立资产参考，不与上述估值方法合并
zh.disc: 方法与数据来源：土地总账面价值 = 5,783.5 十亿盾，为 2025-12-31 审计的（成本法）开发土地账面价值（AR2025 附注 7：Cikarang 3,482.0 + Kendal 746.6 + Tanjung Lesung 1,499.7 + Morotai 55.2）。每股 = 账面价值 × 系数 ÷ 205.9 亿加权股本（AR2025）；对比价为 180.0 盾（2026-09-18 收盘）。此为总资产视角：此处未扣除负债与净债务（总负债 6,911.9；1H26 净债务 1,663.0），故每股数值仅为土地价值，并非股权价值。
zh.note: 仅当每股数值高于市价时显示安全边际；'n/a' 表示土地托底价值低于股价。账面价值为成本口径而非市价：各项目市场挂牌价为账面 2.4x–22.4x（见 Land Bank 页）。75% / 50% / 25% 系数用于说明账面价值折价；实际可回收价值取决于出售时点、地块组合与强制出售折扣。

terms.x: Enterprise Value / EBITDA — a valuation multiple comparing the total value of a business (market cap + debt − cash) to its operating earnings; KIJA ~2.7x on FY25.

Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortisation — a measure of core operating profitability that strips out financing decisions, tax environments and non-cash depreciation/amortisation charges.
Book Value Per Share — shareholders' equity per share; here parent equity 6,263.6 bn ÷ 20.59 bn weighted shares = 304.1 IDR.
Sum-of-the-Parts — valuing a conglomerate by valuing each business segment separately and adding them up.
Weighted Average Cost of Capital — the blended required return of a company's debt and equity holders, weighted by capital structure; used as the discount rate in DCF.
Price-to-Earnings ratio — share price divided by earnings per share; how much the market pays per unit of earnings (8.8x at 180 IDR on FY25 EPS).
Price-to-Book ratio — share price divided by book value per share; below 1 means the stock trades below its accounting net asset value (0.59x at 180 IDR).
Price-to-Sales ratio — market capitalisation divided by annual revenue; a valuation tool that still works when a company has no earnings.
Earnings Per Share — profit attributable to shareholders divided by the number of shares (FY25 audited: 20.55 IDR).
Return on Equity — net profit ÷ shareholders' equity; how effectively equity capital is converted into profit.
Return on Assets — net profit ÷ total assets; how efficiently a company uses all of its resources.
Non-Controlling Interest — the portion of a subsidiary's equity not owned by the parent (minority interest); deducted from consolidated equity to arrive at the parent's share.
Discounted Cash Flow — a valuation method that forecasts future cash flows and discounts them to present value (usually at WACC) to estimate intrinsic value.
Enterprise Value — the theoretical price to buy the whole business: market capitalisation plus total debt minus cash.
Interest Coverage Ratio — operating earnings (EBITDA or EBIT) ÷ interest expense; how many times operating profit covers interest (KIJA 4.4x FY25).
Operating Cash Flow — cash generated from a company's core business operations, before investing and financing activities.
Free Cash Flow — operating cash flow minus capital expenditure; the cash available for dividends, debt repayment or reinvestment.
Year over Year — comparing a figure with the same period one year earlier.
Trailing Twelve Months — the latest rolling 12 months of data (here it includes unaudited 1H26, which drags down EPS).
Debt-to-Equity ratio — total debt ÷ shareholders' equity; how much the company borrows relative to owners' capital.
Special Economic Zone — a designated area with tax, customs and licensing incentives to attract investment (in Indonesia: Kawasan Ekonomi Khusus, KEK).
Joint Venture — a business arrangement in which two or more parties combine resources for a shared project while remaining separate companies.
Indonesia Stock Exchange (Bursa Efek Indonesia) — the sole stock exchange in Indonesia, where KIJA is listed.
Perusahaan Listrik Negara — Indonesia's state-owned electricity utility, responsible for generation, transmission and distribution.
Property, Plant & Equipment — long-term tangible assets (land, buildings, machinery) used in operations.
Liquefied Natural Gas — natural gas cooled to liquid form for easier storage and transport.
Foreign Exchange — currency conversion; an FX loss/gain arises from translating or settling foreign-currency assets and liabilities.
Relative Strength Index — a momentum oscillator on a 0–100 scale; above 70 is considered overbought, below 30 oversold.
Dividend Per Share — the dividend paid out per share (FY25: 2.03 IDR).
Standby Letter of Credit — a bank guarantee to pay a beneficiary if the applicant fails to meet a contractual or financial obligation.
Wastewater Treatment Plant — a facility that treats industrial or municipal wastewater.
Mass Rapid Transit — a high-capacity urban rail system (e.g., Jakarta MRT).
Memorandum of Understanding — a non-binding agreement outlining an intended partnership or cooperation.
Foreign Direct Investment — cross-border investment that gives the investor control or significant influence (typically ≥10% ownership).
Annual General Meeting — the yearly shareholders' meeting where results are presented and resolutions are voted on.
General Meeting of Shareholders — the shareholders' meeting (in Indonesia: Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham, RUPS).
Standard & Poor's — a credit-rating agency and index provider; KIJA's S&P rating is B- (speculative grade).
Moody's credit rating B3 — speculative grade, subject to high credit risk (KIJA's Moody's rating).
S&P credit rating B- — speculative grade, below investment grade.
Key Performance Indicator — a metric used to measure and track business performance.
Beta — a measure of a stock's volatility relative to the market; below 1 means less volatile than the market (KIJA 0.25).
Year to Date — the period from the start of the calendar (or fiscal) year to the current date.
PROPER — Indonesia's corporate environmental performance rating programme run by the Ministry of Environment (KLHK); 'green' is the second-highest level.
First half of the fiscal year (January–June); 1H26 = the unaudited interim period ended 30 Jun 2026.
First half of the year (January–June).
Fiscal Year — the company's annual reporting period; FY2025 = year ended 31 Dec 2025 (KIJA reports on calendar years).
Annual Report — the company's audited annual disclosure to shareholders; e.g., AR2025 = the FY2025 annual report.
Quarter — a three-month reporting period (Q1 = Jan–Mar, Q2 = Apr–Jun, Q3 = Jul–Sep, Q4 = Oct–Dec).
Liquidation value — what shareholders would receive per share if the company's assets were sold and liabilities settled today.
Safety margin — (estimated value − market price) ÷ estimated value; the discount to intrinsic value, shown only when value exceeds price.
Fair value — an estimated intrinsic value of the company derived from valuation methods such as DCF or multiples.
Fair value — an estimated intrinsic value of the company derived from valuation methods such as DCF or multiples.
Liquidity ratios: current ratio = current assets ÷ current liabilities (KIJA 5.6); quick ratio = (current assets − inventory) ÷ current liabilities (KIJA 2.0).
Current Ratio — current assets ÷ current liabilities; a company's ability to cover short-term obligations (KIJA 5.6 at 30 Jun 2026).
Quick Ratio (acid-test) — (current assets − inventory) ÷ current liabilities; a stricter short-term liquidity test (KIJA 2.0).
Dividend Yield — annual dividend per share ÷ share price; the income return from dividends (1.1% at 180 IDR).
Dividend Yield — annual dividend per share ÷ share price; the income return from dividends (1.1% at 180 IDR).
Net Debt — total interest-bearing debt minus cash and equivalents; the debt remaining after using available cash (1H26: 4,863 − 3,200 = 1,663 bn).
Net Debt — total interest-bearing debt minus cash and equivalents; the debt remaining after using available cash (1H26: 4,863 − 3,200 = 1,663 bn).
Gross Margin — (revenue − cost of goods sold) ÷ revenue; the share of sales left after direct production costs (FY25: 39%).
Gross Margin — (revenue − cost of goods sold) ÷ revenue; the share of sales left after direct production costs (FY25: 39%).
Net Margin — net profit ÷ revenue; the share of each rupiah of sales that ends up as bottom-line profit.
Net Margin — net profit ÷ revenue; the share of each rupiah of sales that ends up as bottom-line profit.
Market Capitalisation — share price × number of shares; the total market value of a company's equity.
Market Capitalisation — share price × number of shares; the total market value of a company's equity.
Market Capitalisation — share price × number of shares; the total market value of a company's equity.
Market Capitalisation — share price × number of shares; the total market value of a company's equity.
Land bank — the inventory of developable land held by a property or industrial-estate developer for future sale and development.
Land bank — the inventory of developable land held by a property or industrial-estate developer for future sale and development.
Land bank — the inventory of developable land held by a property or industrial-estate developer for future sale and development.
Refinancing — replacing existing debt with new borrowing, usually on better terms, lower cost or longer maturity.
Refinancing — replacing existing debt with new borrowing, usually on better terms, lower cost or longer maturity.
Leverage — the use of borrowed funds (debt) to finance assets; higher leverage amplifies both returns and risk.
Debt-to-Equity ratio — total debt ÷ shareholders' equity; the company's financial gearing.
Liabilities-to-Equity ratio — total liabilities ÷ shareholders' equity (85% at FY25).
Senior notes — unsecured bonds that rank ahead of subordinated debt in repayment priority.
Term loan — a bank loan repaid in fixed instalments over a set maturity.
Term loan — a bank loan repaid in fixed instalments over a set maturity.
Finance lease — a lease that transfers substantially all risks and rewards of ownership; the asset and liability are recorded on the balance sheet.
Finance lease — a lease that transfers substantially all risks and rewards of ownership; the asset and liability are recorded on the balance sheet.
Dry port — an inland intermodal terminal where cargo is handled away from the seaport (Cikarang Inland Port).
Perseroan Terbatas — Indonesian limited liability company; 'Tbk' after the name means it is publicly listed on the IDX.
Terbuka — Indonesian designation for a company whose shares are publicly listed and traded on the stock exchange.
Kawasan Ekonomi Khusus — kawasan khusus dengan insentif pajak, bea cukai, dan perizinan untuk menarik investasi (special economic zone, SEZ).
Kepentingan Non-Pengendali — bagian ekuitas anak perusahaan yang tidak dimiliki oleh induk (hak minoritas); dikurangkan dari ekuitas konsolidasi untuk memperoleh bagian induk.
Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham — rapat tahunan pemegang saham untuk menyetujui laporan keuangan, dividen, dan keputusan penting perusahaan.
Sertifikat Hak Guna Bangunan — hak untuk mendirikan dan memiliki bangunan di atas tanah milik orang lain/negara, umumnya berjangka 30 tahun dan dapat diperpanjang.
Margin kotor = (pendapatan − beban pokok penjualan) ÷ pendapatan; bagian penjualan yang tersisa setelah biaya produksi langsung (FY2025: 39%).
Margin bersih = laba bersih ÷ pendapatan; porsi setiap rupiah penjualan yang menjadi laba akhir.
Margin aman = (nilai estimasi − harga pasar) ÷ nilai estimasi; diskon terhadap nilai intrinsik, hanya ditampilkan bila nilai melebihi harga.
Utang bersih = total utang berbunga − kas dan setara kas; utang yang tersisa setelah memakai kas yang tersedia (1H26: 4.863 − 3.200 = 1.663 miliar).
Kapitalisasi pasar = harga saham × jumlah saham; total nilai pasar ekuitas perusahaan.
Kepentingan non-pengendali (minoritas) — bagian ekuitas anak perusahaan yang tidak dimiliki induk; dikurangkan dari ekuitas konsolidasi untuk memperoleh bagian induk.
Laba bersih = laba setelah seluruh beban, bunga, dan pajak; laba akhir perusahaan.
Nilai buku (BVPS) = ekuitas per saham menurut pembukuan; aset bersih per saham berdasarkan laporan keuangan.
Nilai likuidasi — nilai per saham yang akan diterima pemegang saham bila aset perusahaan dijual dan liabilitas dilunasi saat ini.
Imbal hasil dividen = dividen per saham ÷ harga saham; imbal hasil dari dividen (1,1% pada 180 IDR).
Dewan Komisaris (board of commissioners) — organ pengawas yang mengawasi direksi atas nama pemegang saham.
Direksi (board of directors) — pengelola harian perusahaan yang bertanggung jawab atas operasi dan strategi.
Rapat Umum Pemegang Saham (RUPS) — rapat tahunan pemegang saham untuk menyetujui laporan, dividen, dan keputusan penting.
Sewa pembiayaan (finance lease) — sewa yang mengalihkan hampir seluruh risiko dan manfaat kepemilikan; aset dan liabilitas dicatat di neraca.
归母净利 = 归属于母公司股东的净利润；从合并净利润中扣除少数股东损益后的部分（FY2025：423.2 十亿盾）。
少数股东权益（NCI）= 子公司权益中母公司未持有的部分；从合并权益中扣除以得出母公司股东权益。
毛利率 =（营业收入 − 营业成本）÷ 营业收入；扣除直接生产成本后剩余的销售占比（FY2025：39%）。
净利率 = 净利润 ÷ 营业收入；每单位收入中最终成为净利润的比例。
净债务 = 有息负债总额 − 现金及等价物；动用现有现金偿还后剩余的债务（1H26：4,863 − 3,200 = 1,663 十亿盾）。
市值 = 股价 × 总股本；公司股权的市场总价值。
土地储备（Land bank）= 开发商持有、备用于未来销售与开发的可开发土地库存。
清算价值 = 假设公司立即清算，资产变现扣除负债后可供股东分配的每股价值。
安全边际 =（估算价值 − 现价）÷ 估算价值；衡量现价相对内在价值的折让空间，仅当价值高于价格时显示。
股东大会（GMS / RUPS）= 公司最高权力机构，股东年度会议审议报告、分红与重大决议。
监事会（Dewan Komisaris）= 代表股东监督董事会（管理层）的监督机构。
董事会（Direksi）= 负责公司日常经营管理与战略执行的机构。
加权股本 = 按期间内流通时间加权平均的股本数，用于计算每股收益（EPS）等指标。
股息率 = 每股股息 ÷ 股价；来自分红的收益回报（1.1%@180 盾）。
归母 = 归属于母公司股东（的口径）；用于区分合并口径与母公司股东口径。
少数股东 = 持有子公司少数股权的非控股股东。
Cash flow from operating activities — net cash generated by the core business in a year; the cleanest earnings-quality check (KIJA FY25: IDR 2,402bn).
Same as CFO: cash actually received from customers minus cash paid to suppliers, staff and tax, before investing/financing.
Capital expenditure — cash spent on property, plant and equipment (not on land inventory). KIJA FY25: IDR 169bn.
See capex; maintenance vs growth capex both reduce free cash flow.
Cash paid to buy new land for the land bank; treated as inventory investment, not PP&E. KIJA FY25: IDR 496bn.
Systematic write-off of fixed asset cost over its useful life; non-cash expense added back in EBITDA.
Write-off of intangible asset cost over its useful life; non-cash, added back in EBITDA.
Earnings before interest and tax = operating profit; sits between gross profit and EBITDA.
Profit from core operations before interest and tax; equals EBIT.
Revenue minus cost of sales; profit before operating expenses.
How much accounting profit turns into actual cash; CFO divided by net profit over a period.

meta.business: 工业园区开发商（Cikarang / Kendal 经济特区），兼营电力、水务、干港等基建
meta.disclaimer: 2026 年为 1H26 未经审计数据；部分历史数字随年报追溯调整。本数据仅作记录与参考，不构成投资建议。

en.sub: Each tied to a measurable gap in the 2015-25 record and a plausible efficiency lever.
items: 1. Scale profit at wholly-owned infra & service segments
Wholly-owned segments (Power, Estate services, Golf, Tourism) contributed IDR 751bn to parent in 2025 vs 369bn in 2024. Power swung from 56 to 316bn; Services 341 to 458bn; Tourism still loses 30bn.

Top 3 levers: (a) keep Power utilization high — Bekasi/United Power is 100%-owned; (b) grow estate services (water, dry port, warehousing, GPM ~46%); (c) turn Tourism around (lost 30bn both years). +50bn at wholly-owned subs → attributable profit 423 → ~473 (+12%).
2. Shift mix to recurring infrastructure
Gross margin fell from ~52% (2015-17 land-sale era) to 39% (2025) as low-margin land recognition grew; recurring infra EBITDA margin holds ~35%.
Power revenue already +54% in 2025; pushing power/water/dry-port volumes to ~60% of revenue would lift blended GPM by an estimated 2-3pct and stabilise quarterly earnings.
3. De-risk land-sale timing
1H26 revenue -11% y/y on recognition timing; quarterly swings ±20%. DSO already improved to 37d and customer deposits rose to 316bn.
Converting more sales to take-or-pay / recurring service contracts and growing the pre-sales backlog would smooth revenue, reduce working-capital volatility and raise cash-conversion certainty.

id.sub: Tiap poin terkait gap terukur di data 2015-25 dan tuas efisiensi yang realistis.
items: 1. Tingkatkan laba segmen infrastruktur & layanan milik penuh

Segmen milik penuh (Listrik, Jasa kawasan, Golf, Pariwisata) menyumbang Rp751 miliar ke induk di 2025 vs Rp369 miliar di 2024. Listrik naik 56→316 miliar; Jasa 341→458 miliar; Pariwisata masih rugi 30 miliar.

Tiga tuas: (a) jaga utilisasi listrik (Bekasi/United Power 100% milik); (b) tumbuhkan jasa kawasan (air, dry port, pergudangan, GPM ~46%); (c) pulihkan Pariwisata (rugi 30 miliar dua tahun). +50 miliar → laba induk 423→~473 (+12%).
2. Geser bursa ke infrastruktur rutin
Margin kotor turun dari ~52% (era penjualan tanah 2015-17) ke 39% (2025) seiring pengakuan tanah; EBITDA infrastruktur rutin tetap ~35%.
Pendapatan listrik sudah +54% di 2025; mendorong volume listrik/air/dry port ke ~60% pendapatan akan menaikkan GPM blended sekitar 2-3pct dan menstabilkan laba triwulanan.
3. Kurangi risiko timing penjualan tanah
Pendapatan 1H26 -11% y/y akibat timing; fluktuasi kuartalan ±20%. DSO sudah turun ke 37 hari dan uang muka pelanggan naik ke 316bn.
Mengubah sebagian penjualan menjadi kontrak take-or-pay / layanan rutin serta memperbesar backlog pre-sale akan memperhalus pendapatan dan meningkatkan kepastian konversi kas.

zh.h: 三大改进优先项（基于历史数据）
zh.sub: 每项对应 2015–25 数据中的可量化差距与可行效率杠杆。
items: 1. 扩大全资基建与服务板块利润
全资板块（电力、园区服务、高尔夫、旅游）2025 年对母公司贡献 751bn（2024 年 369bn）。电力 56→316bn；服务 341→458bn；旅游仍亏 30bn。
三大抓手：(a) 保持电力高利用（Bekasi/United Power 100% 全资）；(b) 做大园区服务（水务、干港、仓储，毛利率 ~46%）；(c) 旅游扭亏（连亏两年 30bn）。全资板块 +50bn → 归母 423→~473（+12%）。
2. 结构转向经常性基建
毛利率从 2022 年 52% 降至 2025 年 39%（低毛利土地确认占比上升）；经常性基建 EBITDA 率稳定在约 35%。
2025 年电力收入已 +54%；若将电力/水务/干港占收入比提至约 60%，综合毛利率可回升约 2–3 个百分点并稳定季度盈利。
3. 降低土地确认时点波动
1H26 收入同比 -11%（确认时点所致）；季度波动 ±20%。DSO 已降至 37 天，客户保证金升至 316 亿盾。
把更多销售转为 take-or-pay / 经常性服务合同并扩大预售订单，可平滑收入、降低营运资本波动、提高现金转化确定性。

en.sub: From CBRE Q2-2026 Greater Jakarta industrial report, Kendal SEZ updates and company disclosures.
items: Reshoring & China+1 to Cikarang
Cikarang remains SEA's largest industrial estate; land prices ~IDR 3.6m/sqm, +4% vs end-2025. EV-battery / nickel downstreaming and auto-electronics are the biggest inbound inflows.
Kendal SEZ momentum
Three new investor MoUs signed Sept 2026 (synthetic leather, garment, hospitality); 144 tenants as of Aug 2026; low Central-Java labour cost suits labour-intensive manufacturing.
2026 sales target 3,750
Company targets IDR 3,750bn marketing sales (Kendal 2,500 / Cikarang 1,250); 1Q26 realised 541bn. Pre-sales backlog supports the recurring-infra thesis.
New products & self-use demand
Jababeka Bizpark phase-I handed over (IDR 1.65bn+ units, won Indonesia Property Award 2026); 1.2m local population and on-site dry port add captive B2C/B2B demand.
Near net-cash balance sheet
Cash 3.6tn vs total debt 4.6tn; USD exposure hedged/cleared; 15-yr IDR funding at 7.0-7.5% — balance sheet now has capacity to fund land banking or buy out JV partners.

id.sub: Dari laporan CBRE Q2-2026 Jabodetabek, update Kendal SEZ dan rilis perusahaan.
items: Reshoring & China+1 ke Cikarang
Cikarang tetap kawasan industri terbesar di Asia Tenggara; harga tanah ~Rp3,6juta/m2, +4% vs akhir 2025. Hilirirasi baterai EV/nikel serta otomotif-elektronik jadi arus masuk terbesar.
Momentum Kendal SEZ
Tiga MoU investor baru ditandatangani Sept 2026 (kulit sintetis, garmen, perhotelan); 144 tenant per Agustus 2026; biaya tenaga kerja rendah Jawa Tengah cocok untuk industri padat karya.
Target penjualan 2026: 3.750
Perusahaan menargetkan penjualan pemasaran Rp3.750miliar (Kendal 2.500 / Cikarang 1.250); 1Q26 terealisasi 541miliar. Backlog pre-sale mendukung tesis infrastruktur rutin.
Produk baru & permintaan sendiri
Jababeka Bizpark fase-I diserahkan (unit mulai Rp1,65miliar, menangkan Indonesia Property Award 2026); 1,2 juta penduduk lokal dan dry port di lokasi menambah permintaan B2C/B2B captive.
Neraca mendekati net cash
Kas 3,6tn vs total utang 4,6tn; eksposur USD dilindungi/selesai; pendanaan IDR 15 thn bunga 7,0-7,5% — neraca kini punya kapasitas membiayai land bank atau membeli mitra JV.

zh.sub: 来源：CBRE 2026 年二季度大雅加达工业地产报告、Kendal 经济特区动态及公司披露。
items: 回流与中国+1 落地 Cikarang
Cikarang 仍是东南亚最大工业区；地价约 360 万盾/平方米，较 2025 年底 +4%。EV 电池/镍下游及汽车电子是最大外资流入。
Kendal 经济特区势头
2026 年 9 月新签三份投资备忘录（合成革、服装、酒店）；截至 2026 年 8 月共 144 家租户；中爪哇低人工成本适合劳动密集型制造。
公司目标营销销售 3.75 万亿盾（Kendal 2.5 万亿 / Cikarang 1.25 万亿）；1Q26 已实现 5,410 亿盾。预售订单支撑经常性基建逻辑。
新产品与自用需求
Jababeka Bizpark 一期交付（单价 16.5 亿盾起，获 2026 印尼地产奖）；本地 120 万人口与区内干港带来稳定 B2C/B2B 需求。
资产负债表近净现金
现金 3.6 万亿 vs 总有息债 4.6 万亿；美元风险已对冲/清除；15 年期盾币融资 7.0–7.5%——资产负债表现有能力支持购地或收购合资方股权。
